description: Local staged delay implementation, linked against build/ GridKit shared libraries. Application cases use DynamicSimulation. Source implementation unchanged during this review.
fixed_step_note: Existing IDA fixed-step mode caps BDF order at 2 and disables its integration error test. Sweep uses loose history rtol=1, atol=.01 to measure error instead of enforcing target accuracy. Adaptive runs use matched solver and history tolerances.
error_note: Sampled maxima include monitor times and every accepted step midpoint. Endpoint errors are reported separately. These are measured errors, not continuous error bounds.
